title: The Great Pumpkin Walk
content:
Join us for Pumpkin Walk Oct. 10, 12 - 6 PM! Free activities, vendors, treats & family fun in Downtown Bellefontaine.

Join Us for the Great Pumpkin Walk in Downtown Bellefontaine!
Sponsored by Small Nation

Gather your family and celebrate the season at one of Downtown Bellefontaine's favorite fall traditions! The Great Pumpkin Walk is an afternoon filled with Halloween fun, festive activities, sweet treats, and plenty of opportunities to make memories together.

Kids can enjoy free trick-or-treating throughout downtown, get creative with free crafts, meet friendly animals at the petting zoo, and laugh along at the puppet show.

Want to make the day even more special? Grab a Pumpkin Passport for access to face painting, inflatables, the candy apple bar, and painting your very own pumpkin to take home.

Whether it's your first visit or a family tradition you've enjoyed for years, the Great Pumpkin Walk is the perfect way to experience the charm of Downtown Bellefontaine while celebrating all things fall.

📅 Event Details

  • Date: Saturday, October 10, 2026
  • Time: 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM
  • Location: Downtown Bellefontaine

Activities

  • Free Trick-or-Treating
  • Free Crafts
  • Free Puppet Show
  • Free Petting Zoo
  • Face Painting (Pumpkin Passport)
  • Inflatables (Pumpkin Passport)
  • Candy Apple Bar (Pumpkin Passport)
  • Paint a Pumpkin (Pumpkin Passport)

title: Holiday Open House
content:
Step into the magic of the season at the Holiday Open House in Ohio’s Christmas Capital! From November 20-22, downtown Bellefontaine transforms into a festive wonderland full of cheer, charm, and holiday spirit.

Don’t miss the grand opening of the Downtown Santa Shed - your chance to snap a photo, drop off wish lists, and kick off the holiday season in style.

Enjoy exclusive holiday shopping discounts from your favorite local shops and boutiques - perfect for checking off your gift list early (and maybe grabbing a little something for yourself too!).

Whether you’re strolling under twinkling lights, sipping something warm, or soaking in the small-town magic, the Holiday Open House is your invitation to celebrate the season right here in Bellefontaine.

Come for the deals, stay for the festive fun - we’ll see you downtown!

title: Hometown Christmas Parade
content:
Watch the streets of Downtown Bellefontaine come alive with festive floats, marching bands, local organizations, and a grand finale appearance by Santa Claus in our beloved annual parade.

The Hometown Christmas Parade is the crown jewel of the holiday season in Downtown Bellefontaine. Thousands gather along Main Street to watch the procession of beautifully decorated floats, school marching bands, dance troupes, and community organizations. Bundle up for an unforgettable evening ending with the arrival of Santa Claus himself.
